## 🎨 Customise all of Stellaria from the app

- **Every setting in one place.** The Stellaria app's Customise page now holds the whole theme in five tabs:
  Appearance (mode, 25 colour schemes, dynamic variants, Windows colours), Wallpaper, Bar, Desktop and Panels.
  <kbd>Win</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd> opens it, and the theme follows the app's language.
- **A bar made yours.** Move each item between the top and the bottom of the bar, reorder or hide it, with a live
  preview. New status icons: microphone (click to mute), Bluetooth and Caps Lock (shown only while it is on).
- **Battery on laptops.** The level on the bar, alerts at 20, 10 and 5 %, a toast when the charger is plugged in or
  out, and a battery card with charge, time left and health in the dashboard.
- **An audio visualiser, if you want it.** Bars that move with the music on your wallpaper, behind your windows. It is
  off by default and nothing is captured while it is off.
- **A frame that fits.** Border thickness and corner roundness are adjustable to the pixel, and **Do not disturb**
  hides the island and the small confirmations while keeping the history.
- **News and roadmap.** A redesigned News page, a Roadmap page, and a short video that shows what is new right after
  the update.
- **Fixes.** Updates no longer show files from the previous version, the newer catalogue always wins after an update,
  Steam games and web links get their own icon in the launcher, and the wallpaper preview is sharp.

Thank you for all the feedback on Reddit and Discord: this version was built from it.

Music of the what's new video: "Surrender" by Healer.
